description.value: Thumper's Patch is a local greengrocer operating out of a retail building on George Ferguson Way, offering fresh produce to the community. For a touring cyclist, it represents a stop for fruits and vegetables that larger chain stores may not emphasize. The shop's focused greengrocer format suggests a farm-stand character that can be a welcome break on a long ride.
